Lux

the Lady of Luminosity
Mid laneSupport lane

Lux is a long-range mage with a double root, a slowing zone and one of the longest ultimate beams in the game. She is easy to pick up and rewards good aim. A great first mid laner for players who want to learn skill shots and poke from a safe distance.

⚖️ Compare with another champion · ⚔️ Look up a matchup

When to pick Lux

✓ Safe blind pick

Fairly safe. Her huge range lets her farm from a distance, but assassins can punish her if your jungler doesn't help.

Pick into

  • Short-range melee mids she can poke from far away, like Irelia and Yasuo
  • Immobile scaling mages, like Azir and Cassiopeia, who can't avoid her poke
  • Slow teams that walk in straight lines: Light Binding catches them
  • Passive teams that want to scale; her poke chips them before objectives

Avoid into

  • Assassins and divers who reach her quickly, like Diana, Zed and Fizz
  • Long-range champions who can trade back, like Vladimir who sustains through poke
  • Teams with lots of dashes that dodge her skill shots easily

Great teammates

LeonaLeona's stuns keep enemies still so Lux's binding and Final Spark always hit.
AmumuAmumu's ultimate stuns a group for a free Final Spark.
MalphiteMalphite's Unstoppable Force knocks up enemies in a line, perfect for Final Spark.

Your team needs: Pick Lux when your team has a frontline to keep assassins away from her, so she can stay back and poke.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Huge range: she can poke and finish kills from far away
  • Light Binding roots up to two targets and sets up kills for her team
  • Final Spark has a short cooldown, so she can use it almost every fight
  • Prismatic Barrier shields her and every ally the wand touches

Weaknesses

  • No dash at all: assassins and divers can reach her easily
  • If Light Binding misses, she has almost no way to stop an attacker
  • Spamming spells drains her mana quickly
  • Has to stay at the back of fights; stepping forward usually means dying

Power spikes

  • Level 3: Q + E + auto-attack hurts a lot. Start trading when the enemy walks forward.
  • Level 6: Final Spark lets you finish kills from huge range and help other lanes.
  • First item (Luden's Echo): stronger poke, faster wave clear and more mana.
  • Two items (Stormsurge): your burst combo can kill squishy champions from out of their range.

Top tips

  • Auto-attack after every spell hit to pop Illumination for free damage.
  • Final Spark has a short cooldown. Use it often, even just to clear a wave or finish a cannon.
  • Shield your jungler with W when they fight the enemy jungler near you.
  • Light Binding still roots a champion behind one minion, so you can throw it through a single minion.
  • Use E as a slowing zone to block the path of someone chasing you.
  • Stand at max range in fights. Lux can do all her damage from far away.
  • Ping the enemy mid when they're missing. Lux can't fight a gank if she doesn't see it coming.
